env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^6$'
stdout '^ada$'
stdout '^7 -1$'
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod
cd out
go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/go/1.27.3/libexec/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/go/1.27.3/libexec/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectconstview

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type User struct {
	Name string
}

func showSlice(xs const []int) int {
	total := 0
	for _, v := range xs {
		total += v
	}
	return total
}

func showPtr(p const *User) string {
	return p.Name
}

func showMap(m const map[string]int, k string) int {
	return m[k] ?? -1
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(showSlice([]int{1, 2, 3}))
	fmt.Println(showPtr(&User{Name: "ada"}))
	fmt.Println(showMap(map[string]int{"a": 7}, "a"), showMap(map[string]int{"a": 7}, "z"))
}
